payload.title: The aria-policy/no-double-type-assertion rule has no exemption although the gate that owns the same ban exempts libs/testing/src/doubles and generated code, so the pack flags the sanctioned stubMember cast, and the gate, the kernel suppression scanner and the pack are three owners of one ban with three different exemption sets and no pin.
evidence: tools/gates/banned-construct.ts:123-136 (the gate exempts the doubles directory for the double assertion)
tools/gates/banned-construct.ts:239-244 (the gate exempts generated paths for every construct)
tools/aria-adapters/lint-rules.eslint.config.mjs:58-67 (the rule reports every assertion to unknown that is itself asserted, with no path logic)
tools/aria-adapters/lint-rules.eslint.config.mjs:107-115 (the policy block has no exemption table)
libs/testing/src/doubles/typed-double.ts:189-190 (the one tested function the gate sanctions for the cast)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/suppression_scanner.py:80-89 (third owner, the kernel scanner lists the same construct and exempts nothing)
tools/aria-adapters/lint-rules-adapter.tool.json:85-96 (the contract judges the finding as a defect in backend code)
payload.rule_violated: One owner per rule (CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach tier 2 and 3): the exemption set of a banned construct is stated once and tied to every enforcer by a pin.
payload.notes: libs is a default root and libs/testing/src/doubles/typed-double.ts is not matched by TEST_FILE_RE, so the pack reports aria-policy/no-double-type-assertion at line 190 (the review probe printed exactly this), while the gate run on the same file reports nothing because the path is exempt. A generated file carrying the standard codegen wrapper would be flagged the same way. The finding reaches the judges as a medium wrong_code claim that the repository itself sanctions, and a new sanctioned path added to the gate never reaches the pack because nothing ties the three tables. Close condition: Export the gate's exemption data (EXEMPT_PATHS plus the per-rule exemptPaths of this construct) from tools/gates/banned-construct.ts and build the pack's ignores for the double-assertion rule from it; add an adapter test that libs/testing/src/doubles and a generated path draw no aria-policy/no-double-type-assertion finding while a sibling path draws one. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 3). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
